Maracas:
FreePats World Percussion, version 2020-09-05.
Recorded January 2019 by Xavimart, Gonzalo and Roberto with two Zoom H1 recorders.
https://freepats.zenvoid.org/Percussion/world-and-rare-percussion.html
https://github.com/freepats/world-percussion
Pinned commit: e54eb2912a0d6d4444ab205d52f778e27da0fc96
License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal public-domain dedication.

The contrabass bar sound uses separate softly played acoustic marimba recordings, not Sonor or Peripole contrabass-bar recordings. The lowest C2 is shifted from the measured F2 marimba source. The soft layer replaces the medium strikes on 2026-10-17; the first 500 ms RMS level is matched to the previous samples, with natural attack and decay retained and no upper-frequency EQ.

See PROVENANCE.json for exact original URLs and SHA-256 hashes, processed-file hashes, measured pitch, level and timing data, and processing details.
CC0 license text: ../CC0-1.0.txt
